launches.title: WOZCODE - Cut your Claude costs by 50%
launches.tagline: A Claude Code plugin that doubles your AI output per dollar
launches.body:
# **Double your AI coding output per dollar spent with WOZCODE**

[WOZCODE](https://www.wozcode.com/) is a plugin that augments Claude Code, making it faster, cheaper and higher performing. It installs in two commands, uses your existing Claude subscription, and fits directly into your current tools and workflows (CLI, Claude Desktop App, VS Code, Conductor, etc.)

<https://youtu.be/ISDH4qsLbrM?si=Pm1g7xXYohUX_UVH>

**Problem:**

Last month, our Claude Code spend crossed $100k.

The scary part wasn’t the total. It was how much Claude wasted by being inefficient. Tool call after tool call that bloated context and burned unnecessary tokens. Claude Code is incredible, but too often it was wasting our tokens and money. As a startup we couldn’t continue burning funds in this fashion. 

So we built a fix.

**Solution:**

[WOZCODE](https://www.wozcode.com/) is a plugin that optimizes how Claude Code works under the hood.

Compared to Claude Code alone, WOZCODE delivers:

* **25–55% cost savings**
* **30–40% faster coding tasks**
* **Higher benchmark performance (Terminal Bench: 70% vs 58%)**

For teams using Claude Code heavily, this can mean:

* 50% Lower API spend
* 2x more AI coding throughput
* 2x more output before hitting limits 

\*checkout[ wozcode.com](http://wozcode.com) for side-by-sides on real world coding tasks

**How it works**

Instead of relying solely on the default tools inside Claude Code, WOZCODE uses a set of custom tools designed for efficiency and context optimization.

For example, in vanilla Claude Code, a simple "find and edit 3 files" takes 9+ calls (3× Glob/Grep + 3× Read + 3× Edit) — and call #9 reprocesses all prior output as input tokens.\
\
WOZCODE collapses that to 2 calls (1× Search + 1× batch Edit). The context stays small, so every subsequent call in the session is cheaper. Over a 30-prompt session, this compounding effect drives significant cost savings.

**See what you could be saving:**

Run the below common in your terminal. It scans your existing Claude Code history and shows you exactly what you could have saved over the last 30 days

            _curl -fsSL [https://wozcode.com/savings-check.js](https://wozcode.com/savings-check.js) | node -_

**Get started for free:**

Sign up at [ wozcode.com](http://wozcode.com)

WOZCODE installs in two commands, uses your existing Claude subscription, and fits directly into your current tools and workflows (CLI, Claude Desktop App, VS Code, Conductor, etc.)

**Help us help you:**

If you’re hitting Claude limits or seeing your spend rapidly accelerate, we’d love to hear from you. The sooner we learn about your use case the sooner we can optimize for it and help you save.

Reach us at [founders@withwoz.com](mailto:founders@withwoz.com)

Thank you!

\-Ben & Brad

launches.title: Woz - Your AI Technical Cofounder
launches.tagline: Launch a software business from scratch, no cofounder required
launches.body:
Hey everyone - we’re [Brad Eckert](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chefeckert/) and [Ben Collins](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bentcollins/), cofounders of Woz. 👋

Woz is an AI platform that empowers non-technical entrepreneurs to build and scale real software businesses–no technical cofounder or engineering team required. To start, we’re helping entrepreneurs build high quality mobile apps and launch them directly to the app store.

<https://youtu.be/DFZ5NCKrV58?feature=shared>

### **Problem:**

For most people, finding a technical cofounder is a frustrating and often insurmountable challenge. AI tools for generating prototypes and toy apps only exacerbate the struggle, leaving non-technical users stranded with no way to get from prototype to customer-ready product. 

### **Solution:**

With a proprietary system of AI agents, **Woz enables you to go from idea to production-ready product, eliminating the need to find a technical cofounder or hire developers.** Simply explain your business idea as you would to a human developer, and Woz handles the rest - product, payments, security, infrastructure, scalability, and more. Once you're up and running, Woz provides the tools you need to reach customers, grow sales, and scale your business, all in one place. Think of Woz as the command center for your business. 

### **What Woz is NOT:**

Woz is **NOT** another no-code tool for generating prototypes, demos, or “toy apps” (e.g. surveys, to do lists, landing pages, etc). Maybe you’ve tried tools like Bubble, Lovable, or Bolt–these tools are fun and easy to use, but they're not engineered for business building. At Woz, we take the opposite approach–starting from battle-tested backend infrastructure and then customizing it to your business. That way, everything built on Woz is ready for customers on day one.

### **Our Team:**

We met 13 years ago as roommates at MIT and have been building companies pushing the limits of AI/ML ever since. Brad previously cofounded Cairns Health (YC S17, formerly Totemic) where he led an engineering team of 30+ and built an LLM enabled device to cure chronic insomnia. We’re joined by a world class team of ML scientists and production engineers who’ve worked together for the last 10 years, scaling products to millions of users. Woz is now a fulltime team of six, and growing. If you’re interested in joining us as we remove barriers to business building, please reach out.  

### **Itching to launch a mobile app?**

👉 Apply for our Beta at [www.withwoz.com](https://www.withwoz.com) or contact us directly at [founders@withwoz.com](mailto:founders@withwoz.com)

**We can’t wait to see what you build!** 🚀 🚀 🚀
